title: Non-survey vessel approval (Exemption 02)
description: Some smaller vessels in sheltered waters can operate without a certificate of survey if AMSA approves them under Exemption 02. Summarised from AMSA's guidance; the exemption's own conditions apply.

items.title: Check the vessel meets the conditions
items.detail: For Class 2, 3 and 4 vessels: under 12 metres, sheltered (D or E) waters only, Class 2 with no more than 4 day passengers, no overnight hire and drive, no inboard petrol engine, no dangerous goods or towage.

items.title: Get a surveyor's written recommendation if you carry net reels, cranes, lifting gear or deck loads
Apply to AMSA with Form 579 and pay the fee
Keep the approval and evidence of eligibility with your safety management system
Remember the vessel still needs a UVI, a certificate of operation (unless exempt) and a safety management system
